name: Pigeon Cay Beach Club
brand_truth: Eight handmade cottages on a private north Cat Island beach that runs on the honor system: a palapa honor bar, free kayaks and bikes, a card held but no deposit, and you pay on departure.
buyer: US and Canadian couples, families and anglers planning months ahead on a phone, many of them repeat guests, who fear hidden costs and remote logistics.
big_idea: A beach club run on the honor system: the first screen says pour your own drink, take a kayak, pay when you leave, and the page lets you work out your own tab with Due today: $0.

direction.why: Their photographs are 380 to 800 px wide (headers 1920x532), so the page is carried by type and colour fields from the palapa thatch and the deep water, with photographs as prints and wide bands at or below real size. A grotesk poster on straw is the opposite of Greenwood's letterboxed film in Noto Serif Display on limestone, and of Fernandez Bay's horizontal journey.

tier_visual_why: A cottage stay is sold by the place and the price, not by an object or an arrival by sea. No 3D. Motion is a two-photo crossfading, slowly drifting band, a spring count on the tab total, and an origin-aware dock.
concept_type: booking: one-page cottage site with a tab planner that hands off to their direct-book engine

critic.by: independent critic mode 2, after one fix pass

critic_note: Self-scores only, awaiting independent critic. Photography is scored 3 because the club's own files are small and uneven and I never saw their pixels.
current_site_findings: No deposit and pay on departure is the last line of the page
Rotating slider of generic lines instead of the honor bar and free kayaks
Eight galleries, 18 wedding photos, 34 gallery photos and 20 FAQs in one scroll
Taxes, meal prices and cancellation terms hidden in pop-ups
Getting here quotes 2016 and 2017 flights and shows a broken FareHarbor widget
pitch_line: Your best promise, pour your own drink and pay when you leave, is the last line of your site. We made it the first.
assumptions: Taxes (VAT 10%, levy 6%) are applied to lodging only in the tab estimate
15% gratuity applied to meals only; taxi fare treated as per trip, not per person
The $5 per person per day ferry surcharge on the fee sheet is left out of the tab because its meaning is unclear
Honor bar wording (it runs on the honor system) is inferred from the name Palapa Beach Honor Bar
Hosts' names Ned and Leslie appear only inside the quoted guest review published on their own site
Cottage one-line descriptions are written from a photo editor's description of the club's own photographs, not from seeing them
Western Air's origin is not stated on their site, so the copy says only that it flies into New Bight
Dates entered in the tab are not passed to direct-book; in production they would be
sources: https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g147427-d151487-r1008992098-Pigeon_Cay_Beach_Club-Cat_Island_Out_Islands_Bahamas.html (guest quote as republished on the club's site)

Weddings section has no photograph because their wedding photos are low quality and show recognisable guests. | 2026-11-21 final check: own photos finally seen through the Lovable gallery screenshot (16 of 72 frames; cottage interiors still unseen, so their filenames are unverified).
